_readme: Home page content: the About section. Image values are ids from tools/media_map.json (see data/manifest.json).
Text is from the owner's ..\Portfolio Revision 3\Revision 3 Instructions.txt, verbatim. In any text, **double asterisks** bold words and [words](page.html) makes a link to another page of the site.
about.subtitle: one line; each " · " separator shows in white.

about.links: contact buttons under the subtitle, in order. "kind": "email" is the email button: js/home.js puts the address together at page load, so it never appears whole in a page or JSON file. "kind": "linkedin" is the LinkedIn icon button (label is its accessible name).
about.bio: the paragraph beside the headshot on wide screens, under the header on phones. "draft": true until the owner sends the final wording; then replace the text and remove draft.
about.gallery_title, about.gallery_intro: the heading and one-line intro above the gallery.
about.gallery: the gallery images in display order, left to right and top to bottom. No captions. home.js lays them out in justified rows and keeps each pair in about.keep_together on the same row.

about.name: Peter Vlahakis
about.subtitle: B.S. Mechanical Engineering · The University of Texas at Austin · May 2027 · Inverness, IL

bio.text: I grew up outdoors, riding, camping, and backpacking with family and friends across Utah, Colorado, and Arizona. Keeping our machines running taught me how things work, starting with a non-running 2001 Honda CR 125 I rebuilt, and that curiosity led me to mechanical engineering. In the shop and on a team, I lead by example, stay organized, and see a problem through to the end. These days I help my dad and his friends build #1283, the Speed UTV El Diablo, over school breaks and on testing trips out west, and I hope to co-drive it in a SCORE race in the coming years.

about.gallery_intro: Riding, hiking, game days, and good music: here's where the rest of my time goes.
